---
title: "Plot eclipse path"
format: html
---


```{r}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggcats)
library(plotly)
library(ggiraph)
library(mapview)
```

# Load data


```{r}
urls <- c(
  # "http://xjubier.free.fr/download/GE/en/TSE_2024_04_08.kmz",
  # "http://xjubier.free.fr/download/GE/en/TSE_2027_08_02.kmz"
  "http://xjubier.free.fr/download/GE/en/TSE_2026_08_12.kmz"
)

dest <- file.path(tempdir(), basename(urls))
walk2(urls, dest, ~ download.file(.x, .y, mode = "wb"))
```


```{r}
layers <- st_layers(dest)
max_point <- st_read(dest, layer = layers$name[1])
path <- st_read(dest, layer = layers$name[2])
path <- path |> filter(Name == "Umbra")
```


```{r}
world <- ne_countries(returnclass = "sf")

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = world,
    fill = "white",
    color = "grey",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = path,
    fill = "orange",
    color = NA,
    linewidth = 0.1,
    alpha = .3
  ) +

  geom_sf(
    data = max_point
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void()

ggplotly(p)
```


```{r}
plot_ly() |>
  add_sf(
    data = world,
    color = I("white"),
    line = list(color = "black", width = .5)
  ) |>
  add_sf(
    data = path,
    split = ~ seq_len(nrow(path)),
    color = I("orange"),
    alpha = 0.3,
    line = list(width = 1),
    text = "Umbral path"
  ) |>
  add_sf(
    data = max_point,
    color = I("black"),
    text = "Max point"
  ) |>

  layout(showlegend = FALSE)
```
